# uzc_account_templates (Data Source)

Lists templates in the caller's own account (GET /account/templates). Distinct from the read-only marketplace catalog exposed by uzc_templates (phase 1).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_account_templates" "all" {}

output "account_template_slugs" {
  value = [for t in data.uzc_account_templates.all.templates : t.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

### Nested Schema for `templates`

- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String) Use this as `template` where an account template slug is needed.
